TheLastKnightMod:BreathOfTheTide.NAME: Breath of the Tide
TheLastKnightMod:BreathOfTheTide.FLAVOR: He caught the scent of the tide and appeared at your side. To him, you mean nothing.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, gain #b6 #yWill. NL At the end of combat, gain an additional card reward.

TheLastKnightMod:AbsurdDestiny.NAME: Absurd Destiny
TheLastKnightMod:AbsurdDestiny.FLAVOR: In Kazimierz, his name was on every tongue. His descendants built a company on his image, and everything he defended with his life became coins in their purses.

TheLastKnightMod:KnightlyBloodAndBone.NAME: Knightly Blood and Bone
TheLastKnightMod:KnightlyBloodAndBone.FLAVOR: Resistance is never without cost. The knight was already covered in wounds, but he never cared. Even if his body were broken to pieces, he would fight to the end.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each turn, gain #b6 #yWill. NL At the end of combat, gain an additional card reward.

TheLastKnightMod:CodeOfChivalry.NAME: Code of Chivalry
TheLastKnightMod:CodeOfChivalry.FLAVOR: Solemn oaths are a thing of the past. Modern chivalry calls for a more flexible approach. Enter your number into the comms device, and you are a proud knight.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, gain [E] for every 100 Gold you have.
